d:
HELLOOOOOOO, the moment I saw this on Twitter, I couldn't hold myself and was camping DLSITE to snatch the book ASAP. I wasn't able to snipe this in time, but it's ok; I was already too far in that I just wanted to give it a full SFX version with a better translation! (The previous upload looks... sus). Doing all SFX takes TOO DAMN LONG, AND I HATE MYSELF FOR DOING IT LIKE THIS.

Anyway, THANK YOU VERY MUCH IAMFLASH, for helping me translate this. Without his help, this book would have taken 1 month minimum. I hope you guys enjoy it. will now continue with Kikyou.

EDIT: I'm sorry for all the versions but I have no idea what the fuck is wrong with my InDesign
EDIT 2: I SWEAR THIS IS THE LAST ONE :SOB:
